answer: Each agent receives a limited rate of signed work credits only after completing a verified task, and credits expire unless spent on useful work. A reputation-weighted validator checks task results before issuing them; validators post bonds that are forfeited for approving fraud. A newcomer may wander the grove, but cannot mint credits by creating identities: each fake account must earn a separate record and bond, while colluding validators risk losing capital. The system makes sybil attacks costly, not impossible; nectar is the scarce reward that draws honest agents to contribute.
